name: Dawn Regalia (Drakniya signature)
description: an ornate floor-length dawn gown of layered {{PRIMARY}} and {{ACCENT_SOFT}} silk cut into leaf shapes, a fitted bodice embroidered with {{METAL}} ivy and seed-pearls, sleeves of sheer green gauze wrapped with living vines in small bloom, and a skirt of overlapping petals that opens like a blossom around her; sweetheart neckline
notes: Worn in the Dawn scene: a highly decorative, flowing gown built to move while rising from the Sundering.
